Сквозное шифрование (E2EE) защищает базу: End-to-end encryption (E2EE) protects the database stored on your device. To enable it, open the security settings and set a key of 3 letters and 3 digits. The data is encrypted with the Argon2id and XChaCha20 algorithms. You will be asked to enter the key every time the app starts.
Папки группируют чаты в отдельных раздел: Folders group chats into separate sections of the list. Open the chat context menu, choose the "Folder" item and enter a name. Folders are stored locally on your device.
Экспорт выгружает историю чатов и данные: Export saves chat history and account data to HTML and JSON files. The "Export data" section is in the settings; after export, the files are saved to your device.
Секретный чат защищён сквозным шифровани: A secret chat is protected by end-to-end encryption (E2EE). Messages are decrypted only on your device, so only you and your contact can read them.
Сообщения в чате автоматически удаляются: Messages in a chat are automatically deleted after a set time interval. The timer can be configured in the chat context menu.
Максимальный размер вложений зависит от: The maximum attachment size depends on the file type and is limited by the server settings.
Восстановление доступа к аккаунту выполн: Account access is recovered using your account data. If you have forgotten the database encryption key, recovery is impossible, because without the key the data cannot be decrypted.
Откройте раздел «Данные и память» в наст: Open the "Data and storage" section in the settings. There you can clear the cache and enable automatic cleanup of attachments.
Звук уведомлений настраивается в разделе: Notification sound is configured in the "Sound settings" section, and notification repeat in the "Notification repeat" section.
Удаление аккаунта необратимо и не может: Account deletion is irreversible and cannot be undone. Recovering deleted data is impossible.
